$comment: SM030: one duty an instrument places on the contractor. Lives nested under an instrument.schema.json document's `obligations[]`, never as a standalone file - an obligation with no instrument has no source. Fields mirror `Obligation` in the monorepo's onboarding.ts prototype plus severity/grade/citation, which that UI-only prototype did not need.
title: obligation v1

key.description: stable id, `<topic>.<short-name>.<form-or-jurisdiction-suffix>`, e.g. `payment.schedule_due.au-qld`. Stable across re-transcription so a correction supersedes rather than duplicates.

duty.description: the duty in one sentence, as a contractor would read it

clause.description: the clause, section or paragraph that states it

window.description: the time the duty allows, when it has one; absent for a standing duty (e.g. 'hold no more retention than the cap')

window_source_field.description: the `contract_terms` field whose value overrides `window.value` when the contract states its own window (SM030 decision 5: contract, an amendment and the law disagree - the strictest wins). Unset means the library's own window is the only value there is to compare.

consequence.description: what missing the duty costs, as the source states it

protection_type.description: the engine that runs this obligation once switched on - a member of vocab/protection_types.json

disease.description: which of the five diseases this obligation guards against - a member of vocab/diseases.json

severity.description: the contract-risk tier this obligation belongs to (1 = entitlement at risk .. 4 = cash position), set by the library author and reviewed in its pull request (SM030 decision 18)

grade.description: how close to the primary source the reading was

basis.description: for a `demiton_default` grade only: the citation this default stands around (must name a real citation elsewhere in the library). A citation grade (`primary_read`/`primary_via_secondary`) must not carry this.

citation.description: the primary source for this exact duty. Required on every obligation: a row with none is refused (SM030 O1 Acceptance) - an instrument's own citation is where the document lives, this is where the clause lives.

evidence.description: how this obligation can be evidenced once switched on - drives the ready state a project sees before the register behind it is connected

from.description: for kind=built_in: what already covers it

system_type.description: for kind=register only: the system type that would fill it

research_row.description: the row id in Demiton's own research record this obligation was transcribed from (e.g. `L1`, `N12`) - traceability, not evidence; carries no research text

caveat.description: what bounds this obligation: an amendment that may change it, a paywalled text read second-hand, a regional exception folded in rather than invented a field for
